This repository contains a Vite + React + TypeScript app for creating Instagram Reels templates.
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling.
- Use Zustand for state management.
- Use @ffmpeg/ffmpeg (ffmpeg.wasm) for client-side video export.
- Use Howler.js for audio preview.
- Use react-beautiful-dnd for the drag-and-drop timeline.
- Use msw for a mock API.

Guidelines for Copilot:
- Keep components small and focused.
- Add TypeScript types for props and state.
- Write unit-test-friendly code.
- Avoid adding external assets; mark placeholders clearly.
